service.name: Corporate holiday party entertainment
service.serviceType: Live bands and DJs for corporate holiday parties
service.description: Live music and DJs for corporate holiday parties in Denver and along the Front Range, November and December 2026, sized to the venue and the program.

faqs.q: Which dates does the Denver holiday season cover?
faqs.a: 21 party dates across November and December 2026, 10 of them in December, covering Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays plus New Year's Eve. The peak December dates are marked, because this market prices a holiday weekend above a standard date. Tell us the date and the venue and we'll check the booking calendar.

faqs.q: When do companies book holiday party entertainment?
faqs.a: August through October is when the season is decided for November and December dates, and New Year's Eve books first of all. Booking early is how you get the date you want; it doesn't change the price.

faqs.q: What does a holiday party band cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the ensemble size the night needs, the hours, and the date. December weekends cost more than a standard date everywhere in this market. We don't publish prices, and what live music costs across this market is set out on our pricing page. Tell us the date and the venue, and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price.

faqs.q: Can one booking cover dinner and dancing?
faqs.a: Yes: a duo through drinks and dinner, then a DJ carrying the back half, on one contract and one load-in.

faqs.q: Can our procurement process clear a booking in time?
faqs.a: Yes, if it starts early. We can be set up as a vendor and quote against a purchase order, and the certificate of insurance, the W-9 and one itemised invoice come with the contract. Vendor onboarding is usually the slowest step of a corporate booking, so it helps to start it when you shortlist.

faqs.q: Can we hold the holiday party in January?
faqs.a: Yes, and a growing share of Denver companies do. Several Denver-area venues now write their holiday packages to run into the third week of January and past it, and the music doesn't change: standards, covers and a dance set were never seasonal. A January date is quoted the way any other date is, so tell us the date and the venue.
